de: Han Seong-sook fordert alle Regierungsbehörden auf, auf die Hitzewelle zu reagieren: „Überprüfen Sie die Schutz- und Sicherheitsregeln für die Schwachen.“ Premierminister Han Seong-sook leitet ein Treffen zur Überprüfung der Reaktionen auf Hitzewellen und Dürren, das am 31. letzten Monats im Seoul Situation Center des Central Disaster and Safety Situation Room im Seoul Government Complex in Jongno-gu, Seoul, stattfand. Yonhap News-Premierminister Han Seong-sook forderte die zuständigen Ministerien und Kommunalverwaltungen dringend auf, aktiv auf ihre Pflichten zu reagieren, da sich die Hitzewelle am 2. verschärfte und in einigen Regionen Besorgnis über Dürreschäden laut wurde. Das Ministerium für Gesundheit und Soziales wurde gebeten, auf gefährdete Menschen wie allein lebende ältere Menschen und Menschen, die in Einzelzimmern leben, zu reagieren.
title: 한성숙, 범부처 폭염대응 당부 “취약계층 보호·안전수칙 점검”
description: 한성숙 국무총리가 지난달 31일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사 중앙재난안전상황실 서울상황센터에서 열린 폭염ㆍ가뭄 대처사항 점검회의를 주재하고 있다. 연합뉴스한성숙 국무총리는 2일 폭염 상황이 심화하고 일부 지역에서는 가뭄 피해 우려도 제기됨에 따라 관계부처와 지방정부에 소관 업무에 대해 적극 대응할 것을 긴급 지시했다.보건복지부에는 독거노인·쪽방 거주민 등 취약···
en: Han Seong-sook requests all government agencies to respond to the heat wave, “Inspect the protection and safety rules for the vulnerable.” Prime Minister Han Seong-sook is presiding over a meeting to review responses to heat waves and droughts held at the Seoul Situation Center of the Central Disaster and Safety Situation Room at the Seoul Government Complex in Jongno-gu, Seoul on the 31st of last month. Yonhap News Prime Minister Han Seong-sook urgently ordered related ministries and local governments to actively respond to their duties as the heatwave situation worsened on the 2nd and concerns about drought damage were raised in some regions. The Ministry of Health and Welfare was asked to respond to vulnerable people such as the elderly living alone and people living in single rooms.
la: Han Seong-sook omnes administrationes imperii postulat ut undae calori respondeat, "Tutelam et salutem inspice regulas vulnerabiles." Primus minister Han Seong-sook praeest conventui ad responsiones recensendas ut fluctus aestus et siccitates in Centro Seoul Situationis Centralis calamitatis et Salutis conclave apud Seoul Imperium complexum in Jongno-gu, Seoul die 31 ultimi mensis tenuit. Yonhap Nuntii Primus minister Han Seong-sook instanter ordinavit ministeria cognata et administrationes locales ut suis officiis actuose responderet sicut condicio caloris die 2 ingravescebat et cura de siccitatis damno in nonnullis regionibus excitabantur. Ministerium Health et saluti rogabatur ut homines vulnerabiles responderent sicut senes soli viventes et homines in singulis conclavibus habitantes.

de: Der Miryang-Staudamm am Nakdong-Fluss und der Pyeongnim-Staudamm am Yeongsan-Fluss haben Dürreniveau erreicht. Da sich die Dürre in der südlichen Region verschlimmert, hat sich die Dürrestufe des Miryang-Staudamms in Yeongnam und des Pyeonglim-Staudamms in Honam erhöht. Das Ministerium für Klima, Energie und Umwelt gab an diesem Tag bekannt, dass der Miryang-Staudamm, ein Mehrzweckdamm in der Nakdong-Flussregion, ab Mitternacht des 2. in die Dürre-Alarmstufe eingetreten ist. Der Miryang-Staudamm in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, versorgt Yangsan-si, Miryang-si und Changnyeong-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do mit Wasser, wo es weiterhin zu extremen Hitzewellen kommt. Die Dürrestufen sind Besorgnis, Vorsicht, Warnung und ernst 4...

description: 남부지방 물 부족 ‘심화’남부지방 가뭄이 심화하면서 영남 밀양댐과 호남 평림댐의 가뭄 단계가 격상됐다.기후에너지환경부는 2일 0시를 기준으로 낙동강권역 다목적댐인 밀양댐이 가뭄 ‘경계’ 단계에 진입했다고 이날 밝혔다. 경남 밀양시에 있는 밀양댐은 극한 폭염이 이어진 경남 양산시, 밀양시, 창녕군 등에 물을 공급한다.가뭄 단계는 관심, 주의, 경계, 심각 4···
en: Miryang Dam on the Nakdong River and Pyeongnim Dam on the Yeongsan River raised to drought level. As the drought in the southern region worsens, the drought level of Miryang Dam in Yeongnam and Pyeonglim Dam in Honam has been raised. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment announced on this day that Miryang Dam, a multi-purpose dam in the Nakdong River region, has entered the drought 'alert' stage as of midnight on the 2nd. Miryang Dam, located in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, supplies water to Yangsan-si, Miryang-si, and Changnyeong-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do, where extreme heat waves have continued. The drought levels are concern, caution, warning, and serious 4...

Cum siccitas in regione meridionali ingravescit, in gradu siccitatis Miryang Dam in Yeongnam et Pyeonglim Dam in Honam evectus est. Miryang Dam, in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do sitam, Yangsan-si, Miryang-si, et Changnyeong-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do, aquam tribuit, ubi aestus nimii permanserunt. de: Hitzewelle, Dürre oder Waldbrand … die ganze Welt leidet unter einer Klimakrise. Am 30. letzten Monats (Ortszeit) zeigt der Fluss Lek bei Beusihem in den Niederlanden sein ausgetrocknetes Flussbett. Associated Press Yonhap News Aufgrund der schlimmsten Hitzewelle und Dürre in der Geschichte hat sich ein gewaltiges Feuer über das ausgetrocknete Gras und den Boden ausgebreitet und die ganze Welt getroffen, unabhängig von Kontinent oder Land. In einigen Ländern wurden Energieversorgungsanlagen wie Kernkraftwerke aufgrund der Dürre abgeschaltet und es gab Warnungen vor drohender Nahrungsmittelknappheit ...
title: 폭염, 가뭄, 아니면 산불···전 세계가 기후위기 몸살
description: 지난달 30일(현지시간) 네덜란드 베우시헴 인근 레크 강이 마른 강바닥을 드러내 보이고 있다. AP연합뉴스사상 최악의 폭염과 가뭄에 메마른 목초와 토양을 타고 일파만파 퍼진 초대형 화재가 대륙과 국가를 가리지 않고 전 세계를 강타하고 있다. 일부 국가에서는 가뭄 피해로 원자력 발전소 등 에너지 공급 시설이 중단됐고, 식량 부족이 목전에 왔다는 경고도 속출하···
en: Heat wave, drought, or forest fire...the whole world is suffering from a climate crisis. On the 30th of last month (local time), the Lek River near Beusihem, Netherlands, is showing its dry riverbed. Associated Press Yonhap News A massive fire has spread through the dried out grass and soil due to the worst heat wave and drought in history, hitting the entire world regardless of continent or country. In some countries, energy supply facilities such as nuclear power plants have been shut down due to drought, and there have been warnings that food shortages are imminent...
la: Calor fluctus, sitis, vel silva ignis... Totus mundus discrimine climatis laborat. Die 30 proximi mensis (loci temporis), Lek flumen prope Beusihem, Nederlandiam alveum suum siccum demonstrat. Consociata Press Yonhap News Ignis ingens per herbam et terram siccatam propter pessimum aestum fluctum et siccitatem in historia diffudit, totum mundum continentis vel reipublicae feriendo. In nonnullis regionibus, energiae facultates copiae ut nuclei plantae ob siccitatem clausae sunt, et monita sunt ut cibi inopias immineant.

de: Von extremen Hitzewellen bis hin zu Dürre … Yeongnam „Wassernotstand“. Pohang gräbt einen Brunnen und Cheongdo bereitet sich darauf vor, das Wasser abzusperren. „Das Dorf ist in Schwierigkeiten, weil es kein Wasser gibt. Es ist schon über 30 Jahre her, also müssen wir das beheben“, sagte Kim Gyu-bok (74), Dorfvorsteher, den wir am 2. in Hwadae-ri, Gigi-myeon, Buk-gu, Pohang, Gyeongsangbuk-do trafen, während wir den Staub von einem rostigen landwirtschaftlichen Brunnen (eine Art Brunnen zum Hochpumpen von Grundwasser) abschüttelten. Dieser Röhrenbrunnen, der vermutlich vor etwa 30 Jahren installiert wurde, wurde in der Vergangenheit zweimal bei schweren Dürren genutzt.
title: 극한 폭염에 가뭄까지…영남 ‘물 비상’
description: 포항은 우물 파고, 청도는 단수 준비“마을에 물이 없어 난리입니다. 30년도 넘은 건데 이거라도 고쳐봐야죠.”경북 포항 북구 기계면 화대리에서 지난 2일 만난 김규복 이장(74)이 녹슨 농업용수 관정(지하수를 끌어올리기 위한 일종의 우물)에 앉은 먼지를 털어내며 말했다. 30여년 전 설치한 것으로 추정되는 이 관정은 과거 극심한 가뭄 때 2번 정도 사용한 ···
en: From extreme heat waves to drought… Yeongnam ‘water emergency’. Pohang is digging a well, and Cheongdo is preparing to cut off water. “The village is in trouble because there is no water. It’s been over 30 years, so we need to fix this,” said Kim Gyu-bok (74), village head, whom we met on the 2nd in Hwadae-ri, Gigi-myeon, Buk-gu, Pohang, Gyeongsangbuk-do, while shaking off the dust from a rusty agricultural water well (a type of well for pumping up groundwater). This tubewell, which is believed to have been installed about 30 years ago, was used twice during severe droughts in the past.
la: Ab aestu nimio ad siccitatem…Yeongnam 'aqua emergency'. Pohang puteum fodit, et Cheongdo aquam abscindere parat. "Vicus laborat quod aqua non est. Iam per XXX annos sic hoc figere oportet", Kim Gyu-bok dixit (74), pagus caput, quem die 2 in Hwadae-ri, Gigi-myeon, Buk-gu, Pohang, Gyeongsangbuk-do, pulverem ex ferrugine aquae bene colendi (typum putei sudoris excutiendum) excutiens. Hoc tubewellum, quod abhinc circiter XXX annos institutum esse creditur, bis in gravibus siccitatibus praeteritis adhibitum est.

de: Während sich die Dürre in der südlichen Region verschärft, erreicht der Milyang-Staudamm am Nakdong-Fluss die „Vorsichtsstufe“ und der Pyeonglim-Staudamm am Yeongsan-Fluss die „Vorsichtsstufe“ für die Dürre. Am 29. des letzten Monats, während die Dürre in der Region Gyeongnam anhält, ist der Baekan-Stausee in Muan-myeon, Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, trocken. An diesem Tag betrug die Wasserversorgungsrate in diesem Stausee nur 1,2 %. Das Ministerium für Klima, Energie und Umwelt teilte mit, dass der Miryang-Staudamm, ein Mehrzweckdamm in der Nakdong-Flussregion, ab Mitternacht des 2. in Dürrewarnung geraten sei.

en: As the drought intensifies in the southern region, the Milyang Dam on the Nakdong River enters the ‘caution’ level and the Pyeonglim Dam on the Yeongsan River enters the drought ‘caution’ level. On the 29th of last month, as drought continues in the Gyeongnam region, Baekan Reservoir in Muan-myeon, Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, is dry. On this day, the water supply rate in this reservoir was only 1.2%. Miryang|Reporter Kwon Do-hyeon As the drought in the southern region intensified, the drought level of Miryang Dam in Yeongnam (located in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do) and Pyeonglim Dam in Honam (located in Jangseong-gun, Gwangju, Jeollanam-do) was raised. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment said that as of midnight on the 2nd, Miryang Dam, a multi-purpose dam in the Nakdong River region, was placed on drought alert.

Ministerium Clima, Energy et Environment dixerunt quasi mediae noctis die 2 , Miryang Dam, multi- rem in regione fluminis Nakdong positam in siccitate intentam esse.

en: 40 degree ‘extreme heat wave’ hits Seoul… The first severe heat wave warning in the metropolitan area. On the 3rd, when a heat wave warning was issued for most of the country, Yeouido as seen through a thermal infrared camera from Seoul Dal, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, is dyed red. Thermal imaging cameras display red when the temperature is high and blue when it is cold. General photos taken with the same composition as the thermal image were layered together. 2026.08.03 Reporter Su-bin Han 40 degrees The extreme heat wave is spreading to the metropolitan area. Gwangyang-si, Gwangju, Jeollanam-do...
la: 40 gradus Item calor extremus fluctum Seoul percusserit… Prima gravis caloris admonitio in area metropolitana. de: [1 Minute Gesundheit] Sorgen Sie während der Hitzewelle unbedingt für Ihre 6080-Gesundheit. [ZD Net Korea] Während die rekordverdächtige Hitzewelle anhält, sind Warnlichter hinsichtlich Gesundheitsrisiken angegangen. Insbesondere die Gesundheit von Menschen ab 60 Jahren oder Menschen mit bestehenden Erkrankungen ist stärker gefährdet und benötigt besondere Aufmerksamkeit. Erstens kann es sein, dass die Schmerzen bei versteckten Krankheiten stärker spürbar werden, wenn die Zeit, die man beim Gehen oder Stehen aufgrund von Reisen oder Gehen verbringt, länger als üblich ist und die Menge an Aktivität zunimmt. Dehydrierung kann bei älteren Menschen zu Veränderungen des Blutdrucks führen. In diesem Fall ist Vorsicht geboten, da die Belastung des Herz-Kreislauf-Systems zunehmen kann. Vor allem, wenn Sie chronische Grunderkrankungen wie Bluthochdruck oder Diabetes haben…

Especially if you have chronic underlying diseases such as high blood pressure or diabetes…

en: [Official announcement] Professional baseball will not be held for 5-6 days due to the unprecedented heat wave... ‘KBO League Emergency’ held on the 6th with an emergency action committee related to the heat wave. A view of Jamsil Stadium on the 4th, when the game was canceled due to a heat wave. Yonhap News As the aftermath of a nationwide heat wave raised a risk to the health of spectators, the KBO decided to cancel all games of the first and second teams for two days. The KBO said on the 5th, “We plan to hold an emergency executive committee meeting on the 6th to discuss comprehensive measures related to the heat wave,” and added, “The KBO League and Futures League, which were scheduled to be held today (5th) and tomorrow (6th), until comprehensive measures are established.”
la: [Denuntiatio officialis] baseball professio non tenebitur per 5-6 dies propter inauditum aestum fluctum... 'KBO League Emergency' die VI cum subitis actionis commissione ad aestum fluctum pertinente habita est. Prospectus Stadium Jamsil die 4 , cum ludus ob aestum fluctum abolitum est. Yonhap News Ut undae caloris nationalis reparata periculum ad spectatorum salutem excitavit, KBO omnes ludos primae et secundae iunctionis per duos dies rescindere constituit. KBO die 5. dixit, "Conventus exsecutivus subitis consilium habere in VI de remediis comprehensivis ad undam aestus pertinentibus", et addidit "The KBO League and Futures League, quae hodie (5th) et cras (6th) habitae erant, donec mensurae comprehensivae constituuntur."

de: [Redaktion] Die Arbeitsunterbrechung aufgrund von Hitzewellen, die lediglich eine Empfehlung darstellt, muss zwingend geändert werden. Innenarbeiter auf einer Baustelle der Korea Flooring Workers' Union stellen ihre Arbeit auf der Baustelle nach, während sie am 29. letzten Monats vor dem Seouler Arbeits- und Arbeitsamt eine Pressekonferenz abhalten, in der sie die Umsetzung von Hitzewellenmaßnahmen fordern. Reporter Su-bin Han Da die durch die Klimakrise verursachten Hitzewellen immer schlimmer werden, scheint die Zahl der Arbeitsunfälle aufgrund hitzebedingter Krankheiten im Sommer jedes Jahr zuzunehmen. In jüngster Zeit gab es eine Reihe von Fällen, in denen Arbeitnehmer aus gefährdeten Gruppen, wie z. B. Wanderarbeiter, bei der Arbeit in der sengenden Hitze starben ...

en: [Editorial] The suspension of work due to heat waves, which is only a recommendation, must be changed compulsorily. Indoor workers at a construction site belonging to the Korea Flooring Workers' Union are reenacting their work at the site while holding a press conference in front of the Seoul Employment and Labor Office on the 29th of last month calling for the implementation of heat wave measures. Reporter Su-bin Han As heat waves caused by the climate crisis become more severe, the number of industrial accidents due to heat-related illnesses in summer appears to be increasing every year. Recently, there have been a series of cases of workers from vulnerable groups, such as migrant workers, dying while working in the scorching heat...
la: [Editorial] Suspensio operis ob aestus undarum, quae tantum commendatio est, necessario mutanda est. Opifices umbraticis in constructione situs Unionis operariorum Coreae Tabulatum rescindunt suum opus in situ dum collationem diurnariam tenentes ante officium Seoul Employment et Laboris die 29 mensis proximi vocantem ad exsequendam mensuras aestus fluctuantes. Notario Su-bin Han Sicut fluctus caloris causatur discriminis climatis graviores fiunt, numerus accidentium industrialium ob æstatem relatarum morborum aestate quotannis crescere videtur. Nuper series causarum operarum ex coetibus nudis factae sunt, ut advenae advenus, dum in aestu aestus operando moriebatur.
